findings.title: Windows timeout may orphan pi install process
findings.problem: With shell: true on win32, the exec timeout terminates the cmd.exe wrapper only; the spawned pi install child can keep running in the background.
findings.impact: Trigger is narrow: a package install exceeding the 300s timeout on Windows. The install then fails with an error and a stray install may finish later; re-running is a cheap workaround.
findings.recommendation: Kill the process tree on timeout (e.g. taskkill /T /F) or document the limitation.
findings.check_notes: exec.ts timeout on win32+shell runs taskkill /pid <pid> /T /F, falls back to child.kill() on spawn error; non-Windows/non-shell path unchanged.

fix.change: exec() kills the whole process tree via taskkill /T /F on Windows shell timeout
